dishes.name: Mouclade
dishes.desc: Bouchot mussels in a creamy, gently curried sauce. The mussels come from the Bay of Aiguillon and the dish is the classic order on the Charente coast.

dishes.name: Chaudrée
dishes.desc: A Charentaise fish stew with white wine, built on a mix of small sea fish. The local cousin of Brittany's cotriade and often compared to bouillabaisse.

dishes.name: Galette charentaise
dishes.desc: A soft, buttery regional cake flavoured with candied angelica. Eaten with coffee or as an afternoon snack across Charente-Maritime.

dishes.name: Grillon charentais
dishes.desc: Slow-cooked, seasoned pork eaten on fresh bread, traditionally as an aperitif or picnic food. Less known to visitors but a local favourite.

dishes.name: Cagouilles
dishes.desc: Small grey snails of the Charente, pan-fried or stewed slowly in white wine with a touch of cognac. A rustic dish of the region.
